title: Tinglab tushunish: asosiy g‘oya va tafsilot
goal_uz: Dars oxirida siz 3–5 daqiqalik ma’ruzani tinglab, ikki ustunli qaydda asosiy g‘oya va kamida beshta tafsilotni yozasiz, so‘zlovchining munosabatini aniqlaysiz, chalg‘ituvchi javoblarga tushmaysiz va parafrazlangan savollarga to‘g‘ri javob berasiz.

scenes.title: Tinglab tushunish
scenes.say: Hello again. Last time we discussed education and technology. Today we focus on listening: catching the main idea, keeping the key details and avoiding exam traps.
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda ta’lim va texnologiya haqida muvozanatli mulohaza tuzishni o‘rgandik. Bugun tinglab tushunish ustida ishlaymiz. Dars oxirida siz ma’ruzani tinglab tartibli qayd yozasiz, so‘zlovchining munosabatini aniqlaysiz, chalg‘ituvchi javoblarga tushmaysiz va parafrazni taniysiz.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom. Oldingi safar ta’lim va texnologiyani muhokama qildik. Bugun tinglashga e’tibor qaratamiz: asosiy g‘oyani ilg‘ash, muhim tafsilotlarni saqlash va imtihon tuzoqlaridan qochish.

scenes.title: Asosiy g‘oya va tafsilot
board: main idea = what the whole talk is about (umumiy mazmun)
detail = a fact, number, name, reason (aniq ma’lumot)

examples.t: The talk is mainly about why people move to cities.
examples.uz: Ma’ruza asosan odamlar nega shaharlarga ko‘chishi haqida.

scenes.say: The main idea answers the question: what is this mostly about? A detail is a specific fact: a number, a name or a reason. Good listeners follow both.
scenes.say_native: Har bir tinglash matnida ikki daraja bor. Asosiy g‘oya, ya’ni “bu umuman nima haqida?” savoliga javob. Va tafsilot: raqam, sana, ism, sabab. Ko‘pchilik har bir so‘zni tushunishga urinib, umumiy mazmunni yo‘qotadi. Radioda o‘zbekcha yangilik eshitganda ham avval mavzuni, keyin raqamlarni ilg‘aysiz. Ingliz tilida ham shunday tinglang.
scenes.say_uz: Asosiy g‘oya “bu asosan nima haqida?” savoliga javob beradi. Tafsilot esa aniq fakt: raqam, ism yoki sabab. Yaxshi tinglovchi ikkalasini kuzatadi.

scenes.title: Tinglashdan oldin bashorat

examples.t: How long did the project take? → expect a time period
examples.uz: Loyiha qancha vaqt oldi? → vaqt oralig‘ini kuting

scenes.say: Before the recording starts, read the questions, underline the key words and predict the type of answer. How long means a period of time. Who means a person.
scenes.say_native: Imtihonda yozuvdan oldin savollarni o‘qish uchun vaqt beriladi. Uni behuda o‘tkazmang. Kalit so‘zlarning tagiga chizing va javob turini taxmin qiling: raqammi, ismmi, joymi. “How long” bo‘lsa, “three weeks” kabi vaqt oralig‘ini kutasiz. Miya nimani izlashini bilsa, uni eshitganda darhol sezadi.
scenes.say_uz: Yozuvdan oldin savollarni o‘qing, kalit so‘zlarning tagiga chizing va javob turini taxmin qiling. “Qancha vaqt” vaqt oralig‘ini, “kim” esa odamni bildiradi.

scenes.title: Qayd yozish tuzilmasi
board: One idea per line, leave space

examples.t: cities growing | 55% of people now, 68% by 2050

scenes.say: A simple note structure has two columns: main points on the left, supporting details on the right. Write one idea per line and use key words, not sentences.
scenes.say_native: Eng oddiy va samarali tuzilma ikki ustun. Chapga asosiy fikrlar, o‘ngga ularni tasdiqlovchi tafsilotlar. Har qatorga bitta fikr yozing va joy qoldiring, chunki so‘zlovchi ko‘pincha oldingi fikriga qaytadi. Faqat kalit so‘zlar: ot, raqam, ma’noli fe’l. Diktant kabi so‘zma-so‘z yozish odati bu yerda xalaqit beradi.
scenes.say_uz: Oddiy qayd tuzilmasi ikki ustundan iborat: chapda asosiy fikrlar, o‘ngda tafsilotlar. Har qatorga bitta fikr yozing, gap emas, kalit so‘zlar ishlating.

scenes.title: Belgilar va qisqartmalar
board: b/c because  w/ with  w/o without
approx. about  govt government  ppl people

examples.uz: odamlar shaharga ko‘chmoqda, chunki ish bor → ijara oshmoqda

scenes.say: Symbols save time. An arrow up means an increase, an arrow down a fall. Build your own system and use it every time.
scenes.say_native: Belgilar va qisqartmalar soniyalarni tejaydi. Yuqoriga strelka o‘sish, pastga strelka kamayish, yonga strelka “olib keladi”. B/C bu because, W/ bu with, approx. bu taxminan. Plyus afzallik, minus kamchilik. O‘zingizga qulay tizim tuzing, lekin uni doim bir xil ishlating va keyin o‘zingiz o‘qiy oladigan bo‘lsin.
scenes.say_uz: Belgilar vaqtni tejaydi. Yuqoriga strelka o‘sish, pastga kamayish. O‘z tizimingizni tuzing va doim ishlating.

scenes.title: Namunaviy qaydlar
board: MAIN: cycling ↑ | DET: London approx. +40% in 5 yrs
MAIN: reasons | DET: cheap, fit, faster than traffic
MAIN: problems | DET: feel unsafe, few bike lanes
scenes.say: Listen. Cycling in cities is growing. In London, daily cyclists have risen by about forty per cent in five years. It's cheap, healthy and faster than traffic. However, many feel unsafe because there aren't enough bike lanes.
scenes.say_native: Endi bu parcha qanday qayd qilinganini doskada ko‘ring. Chapda uchta asosiy fikr: velosipedchilar ko‘paymoqda, sabablari va muammolari. O‘ngda tafsilotlar: London, besh yilda qirq foiz, arzon, sog‘lom, tirbandlikdan tez, xavfsizlik va yo‘laklar kamligi. To‘liq gap yo‘q, lekin mazmun to‘liq saqlangan.
scenes.say_uz: Tinglang. Shaharlarda velosipedda yurish ko‘paymoqda. Londonda kundalik velosipedchilar besh yilda taxminan qirq foizga ko‘paydi. Bu arzon, foydali va tirbandlikdan tez. Biroq ko‘pchilik o‘zini xavfsiz his qilmaydi, chunki velosiped yo‘laklari yetarli emas.

scenes.title: Ishora so‘zlari
board: Topic: Today I’d like to talk about…
New point: Another key factor is… / Moving on to…
scenes.say: Signposts show structure. Moving on to means a new main point, so start a new line. To sum up repeats the main idea.
scenes.say_native: So‘zlovchilar sizni ishora iboralari bilan yo‘naltiradi. “Today I’d like to talk about” mavzuni aytadi. “Another key factor is” yoki “Moving on to” yangi asosiy fikrni bildiradi, demak qaydda yangi qator oching. “For instance” misol beradi. “To sum up” asosiy g‘oyani takrorlaydi.
scenes.say_uz: Ishora so‘zlari tuzilmani ko‘rsatadi. “Endi ... ga o‘tsak” yangi asosiy fikr, demak yangi qator oching. “Xulosa qilib aytganda” asosiy g‘oyani takrorlaydi.

scenes.title: Qayddagi tipik xatolar
board: ✗ Writing every word → you miss the next point
scenes.say: Don't try to write everything. While you write one sentence, the speaker moves on. And don't write one long block, or you won't separate main points from details.
scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato hamma narsani yozishga urinish. Bitta gapni yozguningizcha so‘zlovchi keyingi fikrga o‘tadi va siz uni boy berasiz. Ikkinchi xato tuzilmasiz uzun bo‘lak yozish, keyin asosiy fikrni tafsilotdan ajrata olmaysiz. Yodda tuting: qayd diktant emas, xotirangiz uchun ishora.
scenes.say_uz: Hamma narsani yozishga urinmang. Bitta gapni yozguningizcha so‘zlovchi davom etadi. Uzun bo‘lak ham yozmang, aks holda asosiy fikrni tafsilotdan ajrata olmaysiz.

scenes.title: Qayd yozib ko‘ring
scenes.say: Make notes. Since twenty twenty, working from home has grown sharply. In the UK, roughly one in four workers now does it at least part of the week. Employees save time and money on travel. Managers, however, worry about teamwork and training new staff.
scenes.say_native: Endi navbat sizda. Qog‘ozga ikki ustun chizing. Parchani tinglang va bitta asosiy g‘oya hamda kamida uchta tafsilotni yozing. Faqat kalit so‘zlar, raqamlar va belgilar ishlating. Kerak bo‘lsa, yana bir bor tinglang. Keyin namunaviy qayd bilan solishtiramiz.
scenes.say_uz: Qayd yozing. 2020-yildan beri uydan ishlash keskin o‘sdi. Britaniyada hozir taxminan har to‘rt xodimdan biri haftaning bir qismida shunday ishlaydi. Xodimlar yo‘lda vaqt va pul tejaydi. Rahbarlar esa jamoaviy ish va yangi xodimlarni o‘qitishdan xavotirda.

scenes.title: Javob: namunaviy qayd
board: DET: UK approx. 1 in 4, part of week
scenes.say: Here is a model. Main idea: working from home has grown sharply. Details: one in four UK workers, savings on travel, and managers' concerns.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna. Asosiy g‘oya: uydan ishlash 2020-yildan beri keskin o‘sdi. Tafsilotlar: Britaniyada taxminan to‘rtdan bir xodim, haftaning bir qismida. Plyus: yo‘lda vaqt va pul tejaladi. Minus: rahbarlar jamoaviy ish va o‘qitishdan xavotirda. Plyus va minus belgilari afzallik va kamchilikni bir qarashda ajratadi.
scenes.say_uz: Namuna. Asosiy g‘oya: uydan ishlash keskin o‘sdi. Tafsilotlar: Britaniyada to‘rtdan bir xodim, yo‘ldagi tejash va rahbarlarning xavotirlari.

scenes.title: Munosabat: so‘zlar orqali

examples.t: Frankly, the new timetable is a disaster.
I’m not entirely convinced it will work.

scenes.say: Attitude is how the speaker feels. Listen for words like frankly, sadly or pointless. I'm not entirely convinced is a polite way to disagree.
scenes.say_native: Munosabat, ya’ni so‘zlovchi mavzuga qanday qaraydi. Birinchi belgi baholovchi so‘zlar: frankly, surprisingly, sadly kabi ravishlar va impressive, pointless kabi sifatlar. Ikkinchi belgi yumshatilgan til. Inglizlar kamdan kam to‘g‘ridan to‘g‘ri “I disagree” deydi. “I’m not entirely convinced” aslida “qo‘shilmayman” degani.
scenes.say_uz: Munosabat so‘zlovchining his-tuyg‘usi. Frankly, sadly yoki pointless kabi so‘zlarga quloq soling. “To‘liq ishonmayman” qo‘shilmaslikning muloyim shakli.

scenes.title: Munosabat: ohang orqali
scenes.say: Attitude is in the voice too. Oh great, another meeting, said slowly and low, is sarcasm. A fall-rise, as in it's quite good, suggests an unspoken but.
scenes.say_native: Munosabat ovozda ham bor. Past, bir tekis ovoz zerikish yoki befarqlikni bildiradi. “Oh, great. Another meeting” sekin va past aytilsa, bu kinoya, ya’ni aksi nazarda tutiladi. Gap oxirida ohang pasayib, keyin ko‘tarilsa, “it’s quite good” kabi, bu aytilmagan “lekin”. O‘zbekchada ham “ha, zo‘r-ku” ba’zan kinoya bo‘ladi.
scenes.say_uz: Munosabat ovozda ham bor. Sekin va past aytilgan “Voy, zo‘r, yana majlis” kinoya. Pasayib-ko‘tariluvchi ohang aytilmagan “lekin”ni bildiradi.

scenes.title: Munosabat so‘zlari

examples.t: She sounds sceptical about the plan.
examples.uz: U rejaga shubha bilan qarayotganga o‘xshaydi.

scenes.say: Exam options use attitude words. Sceptical means doubtful, critical means pointing out faults, ambivalent means mixed feelings, and indifferent means not caring.
scenes.say_native: Imtihon variantlarida munosabat so‘zlari ko‘p keladi. Sceptical, shubhali. Enthusiastic, ishtiyoqli. Critical, tanqidiy. Ambivalent, ikkilangan. Indifferent, befarq. Cautious, ehtiyotkor. Diqqat: sympathetic ruscha “симпатичный” emas, ya’ni “yoqimtoy” degani emas. U “hamdard, tushunadigan” ma’nosini beradi.
scenes.say_uz: Imtihon variantlarida munosabat so‘zlari uchraydi. Sceptical shubhali, critical kamchilikni ko‘rsatuvchi, ambivalent aralash hisli, indifferent befarq.

scenes.title: Munosabatdagi tuzoqlar
board: “I couldn’t agree more” = I totally agree
“I couldn’t care less” = I don’t care at all
scenes.say: Careful. Not bad means quite good. I couldn't agree more means total agreement. And in it's impressive, but I doubt it will last, the attitude is sceptical.
scenes.say_native: Bu iboralarda ko‘p adashiladi. “Not bad” yomon emas, aksincha “ancha yaxshi”. “I couldn’t agree more” inkor shaklida bo‘lsa ham, “to‘liq qo‘shilaman”. “I couldn’t care less” esa “mutlaqo farqi yo‘q”. Bitta ijobiy so‘z butun munosabatni ijobiy qilmaydi: “but”dan keyingi qism asosiy fikr.
scenes.say_uz: Ehtiyot bo‘ling. “Not bad” ancha yaxshi degani. “Bundan ortiq qo‘shila olmayman” to‘liq qo‘shilish. “Ta’sirli, lekin uzoq davom etishiga shubham bor” gapida munosabat shubhali.

scenes.title: Munosabatni aniqlang
board: 1) “Honestly, I couldn’t care less which one we choose.”
2) “It sounds good on paper, but I’m not sure it’ll work.”
3) “Best idea in years!”  4) “Frankly, it was badly organised.”
scenes.say: What is the attitude? One: honestly, I couldn't care less which one we choose. Two: it sounds good on paper, but I'm not sure it'll work. Three: this is the best idea we've had in years! Four: frankly, it was badly organised.
scenes.say_native: To‘rt gapni tinglang va har biriga munosabat tanlang: enthusiastic, sceptical, critical yoki indifferent. Har bir so‘z bir marta ishlatiladi. So‘zlarga ham, ohangga ham quloq soling, ayniqsa “but”dan keyin nima kelishiga. Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Munosabat qanday? Bir: rostini aytsam, qaysi birini tanlashimiz menga farqi yo‘q. Ikki: qog‘ozda yaxshi, lekin ishlashiga ishonmayman. Uch: bu yillar davomidagi eng yaxshi g‘oya! To‘rt: ochig‘i, yomon tashkil qilingan edi.

scenes.title: Javoblar: munosabat
scenes.say: One, indifferent. Two, sceptical. Three, enthusiastic. Four, critical.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: indifferent, “couldn’t care less” befarqlik. Ikki: sceptical, “good on paper” ijobiy ko‘rinsa ham, “but I’m not sure” shubha. Uch: enthusiastic, “the best idea” va ko‘tarinki ohang. To‘rt: critical, “badly organised”. Farqni eslang: sceptical natijaga ishonmaslik, critical esa aniq kamchiliklarni ko‘rsatish.
scenes.say_uz: Bir, befarq. Ikki, shubhali. Uch, ishtiyoqli. To‘rt, tanqidiy.

scenes.title: Dialog: yangi ofis qoidasi
scenes.say: Kate: Have you seen the email? From March we have to be in the office three days a week. Tom: Three? I thought it was two. Kate: It was two in the first draft, but they changed it. Tom: Frankly, it's a step backwards. My commute is an hour each way. Kate: I see why you're annoyed, but I actually miss seeing people. Tom: I suppose. I'm just not convinced it'll make us more productive.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash. Ikki hamkasb, Kate va Tom, ofisdagi yangi qoida haqida gaplashmoqda. Uch narsaga e’tibor bering: qoida nimani talab qiladi, raqam qanday o‘zgargan va har bir so‘zlovchining munosabati. Ikki ustunli qayd yozing, keyin savollarga javob berasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Kate: Xatni ko‘rdingmi? Martdan haftasiga uch kun ofisda bo‘lishimiz kerak. Tom: Uch? Ikki deb o‘ylagandim. Kate: Birinchi loyihada ikki edi, o‘zgartirishdi. Tom: Ochig‘i, bu orqaga qadam. Yo‘lim har tomonga bir soat. Kate: Asabiylashganingni tushunaman, lekin men aslida odamlarni sog‘inganman. Tom: Shunday bo‘lsa kerak. Faqat bu bizni samaraliroq qilishiga ishonmayman.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
board: 1) How many office days a week?
4) Kate’s attitude: mainly positive or negative?
scenes.say: One: how many days a week must they be in the office? Two: when does it start? Three: what is Tom's attitude? Four: is Kate mainly positive or negative?
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savolga javob bering. Birinchisida ehtiyot bo‘ling: dialogda ikkita raqam eshitildi, qaysi biri yakuniy? Ikkinchisi sana haqida. Uchinchi va to‘rtinchi savollar munosabat haqida, shuning uchun Tom va Kate ishlatgan baholovchi so‘zlarni eslang. Javobni to‘liq gap bilan ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: haftasiga necha kun ofisda bo‘lishlari kerak? Ikki: qachon boshlanadi? Uch: Tomning munosabati qanday? To‘rt: Kate asosan ijobiymi yoki salbiy?

scenes.title: Javoblar: birinchi dialog
board: 4) mainly positive: “I actually miss seeing people”
scenes.say: One, three days. Two was only the first draft. Two, from March. Three, Tom is critical. Four, Kate is mainly positive.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: uch kun. Ikki faqat birinchi loyihada edi, bu chalg‘ituvchi, uni hozir o‘rganamiz. Ikki: martdan. Uch: Tom tanqidiy, “a step backwards” deydi, “not convinced” bilan shubhasini ham bildiradi. To‘rt: Kate asosan ijobiy. “Actually” bu yerda u Tomni tushunsa ham, boshqacha o‘ylashini ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say_uz: Bir, uch kun, ikki faqat birinchi loyiha edi. Ikki, martdan. Uch, Tom tanqidiy. To‘rt, Kate asosan ijobiy.

scenes.title: Chalg‘ituvchilar nima?
board: Distractor = sounds right, but is NOT the answer

examples.t: We thought about Friday, but in the end we chose Saturday.
examples.uz: Jumani o‘yladik, lekin oxiri shanbani tanladik.

scenes.say: A distractor sounds like the answer but isn't. Speakers often mention two or three options, reject some and choose one. Wait for the final decision.
scenes.say_native: Chalg‘ituvchi, ya’ni distractor, javobga o‘xshab eshitiladigan, lekin javob bo‘lmagan ma’lumot. Yozuvlarda so‘zlovchilar ataylab ikki-uch variantni aytadi: birini o‘ylaydi, rad etadi, boshqasini tanlaydi. Vazifangiz yakuniy qarorni kutish. Tinglash imtihonlarida eng ko‘p ball aynan shu yerda yo‘qotiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Chalg‘ituvchi javobga o‘xshaydi, lekin javob emas. So‘zlovchilar ko‘pincha ikki-uch variantni aytib, ba’zisini rad etib, bittasini tanlaydi. Yakuniy qarorni kuting.

scenes.title: Chalg‘ituvchi turlari
board: Changed plans: “It used to be… but now…”
Rejected option: “We could take the bus, but…”
Two facts close together: £20 adults, £12 children

examples.t: It used to start at nine, but now it starts at half past eight.
examples.uz: Avval to‘qqizda boshlanardi, endi sakkiz yarimda.

scenes.say: Four common types: self-correction, changed plans, rejected options, and two similar facts close together, such as prices for adults and children.
scenes.say_native: To‘rt asosiy tur bor. Birinchi: so‘zlovchi o‘zini to‘g‘rilaydi, “the 14th, sorry, the 15th”. Ikkinchi: reja o‘zgargan, “it used to be... but now”. Uchinchi: variant rad etiladi, “we could take the bus, but it’s too slow”. To‘rtinchi: yaqin ikki fakt, masalan kattalar va bolalar narxi.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt keng tarqalgan tur: o‘zini to‘g‘rilash, reja o‘zgarishi, rad etilgan variant va bir-biriga yaqin ikki fakt, masalan kattalar va bolalar narxi.

scenes.title: Burilish so‘zlari
board: sorry, I mean… / or rather… → real answer

examples.t: Let’s meet at the café. Actually, the library is quieter.

scenes.say: Some words warn you the answer is changing: actually, in fact, sorry I mean, or rather, on second thoughts, and but or however. Keep your pen ready.
scenes.say_native: Ba’zi so‘zlar javob o‘zgarishidan ogohlantiradi. “Actually” va “in fact” ko‘pincha tuzatishni boshlaydi. “Sorry, I mean” va “or rather” haqiqiy javobni beradi. “On second thoughts” reja o‘zgarganini bildiradi. “But”, “however” oldingi variantni rad etadi. Diqqat: “actually” ruscha “актуально” emas, “aslida” degani.
scenes.say_uz: Ba’zi so‘zlar javob o‘zgarishidan ogohlantiradi: aslida, kechirasiz demoqchimanki, yaxshilab o‘ylasam, lekin, biroq. Qalamingizni tayyor tuting.

scenes.title: Shakl to‘ldirishda chalg‘ituvchi
board: Breakfast: used to be included → now £6 extra ✓
scenes.say: Receptionist: So that's two nights, arriving on the fourteenth. Guest: No, sorry, the fifteenth. Receptionist: Fine. It's usually forty pounds a night, but this week it's thirty-five. Guest: And breakfast? Receptionist: It used to be included, but now it's six pounds extra.
scenes.say_native: Mehmonxonada shakl to‘ldirilmoqda. Har bir maydon uchun ikki variant eshitiladi, lekin faqat bittasi to‘g‘ri. Sana o‘n beshinchi, chunki mehmon “sorry” deb tuzatdi. Narx o‘ttiz besh funt, chunki “but this week”. Nonushta esa endi qo‘shimcha olti funt. Har safar “sorry” va “but” yakuniy javobni ko‘rsatdi.
scenes.say_uz: Qabulxonachi: Demak, ikki kecha, o‘n to‘rtinchida kelasiz. Mehmon: Yo‘q, kechirasiz, o‘n beshinchi. Qabulxonachi: Xo‘p. Odatda kechasiga qirq funt, lekin bu hafta o‘ttiz besh. Mehmon: Nonushta-chi? Qabulxonachi: Avval kiritilgan edi, endi olti funt qo‘shimcha.

scenes.title: Birinchi eshitganini yozish
board: ✓ Wait for the end of the turn → 15th
✓ Write lightly in notes, confirm, then finalise
scenes.say: The classic mistake: you hear the fourteenth, write it and stop listening, so you miss the correction. Wait until the speaker finishes the turn.
scenes.say_native: Klassik xato: birinchi eshitgan javobni yozib, tinglashni to‘xtatish. “The 14th”ni yozasiz, xotirjam bo‘lasiz va tuzatish quloqdan o‘tib ketadi. So‘zlovchi gapini tugatguncha kuting. Tez yozish kerak bo‘lsa, qaydga yengil yozing, keyin tekshiring va faqat ishonch hosil qilgach javoblar varag‘iga ko‘chiring.
scenes.say_uz: Klassik xato: o‘n to‘rtinchini eshitib yozasiz va tinglashni to‘xtatasiz, keyin tuzatishni boy berasiz. So‘zlovchi gapini tugatguncha kuting.

scenes.title: Yakuniy javobni toping
board: 3) How much is a student ticket?
scenes.say: One: the tour starts at ten. Oh wait, this month it's half past ten. Two: we could drive, but parking is a nightmare, so let's take the train. Three: adults pay fifteen pounds and students nine, or seven if they book online.
scenes.say_native: Uchta qisqa parchani tinglang va yakuniy javobni yozing. Har birida kamida ikki variant bor. Burilish so‘zlariga quloq soling: “oh wait”, “but”, “or”. Uchinchi savolda ehtiyot bo‘ling: savol aynan kim haqida? Kerak bo‘lsa, ikkala variantni ham yozing.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: sayohat o‘nda boshlanadi. Ha, to‘xtang, bu oy o‘n yarimda. Ikki: mashinada borsak bo‘lardi, lekin to‘xtash joyi dahshat, poyezdda boraylik. Uch: kattalar o‘n besh funt, talabalar to‘qqiz, onlayn band qilsa yetti funt to‘laydi.

scenes.title: Javoblar: chalg‘ituvchilar
scenes.say: One, half past ten. Two, by train. Three, nine pounds, or seven online. Fifteen is the adult price.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: o‘n yarim, “oh wait” tuzatishni bildirdi. Ikki: poyezdda, mashina “but parking is a nightmare” bilan rad etildi. Uch: to‘qqiz funt, onlayn bo‘lsa yetti. O‘n besh funt kattalar narxi, bu klassik chalg‘ituvchi: raqam to‘g‘ri eshitilgan, lekin boshqa odamga tegishli.
scenes.say_uz: Bir, o‘n yarim. Ikki, poyezdda. Uch, to‘qqiz funt, onlayn yetti. O‘n besh kattalar narxi.

scenes.title: Parafraz: bir fikr, boshqa so‘zlar
board: Questions rarely repeat the recording’s words

examples.t: “We made the decision to reduce spending.” = They decided to cut costs.

scenes.say: Paraphrase means the same idea in different words. Questions use synonyms, other word forms, or a negative with an opposite, like not cheap for expensive.
scenes.say_native: Parafraz, ya’ni bir fikrni boshqa so‘zlar bilan ifodalash. Imtihon savollari yozuvdagi so‘zlarni deyarli hech qachon aynan takrorlamaydi. Sinonim: reduce va cut. Boshqa so‘z shakli: decision va decided. Inkor va qarama-qarshi so‘z: not cheap, ya’ni expensive. Shuning uchun so‘zni emas, ma’noni tinglang.
scenes.say_uz: Parafraz bir fikrni boshqa so‘zlar bilan aytish. Savollar sinonim, boshqa so‘z shakli yoki inkor bilan qarama-qarshi so‘z ishlatadi: arzon emas, ya’ni qimmat.

scenes.title: Parafraz turlari
board: Active ↔ passive: They built it ↔ It was built

examples.t: The meeting has been put off. = The meeting has been postponed.

scenes.say: More types: active and passive, general and specific words, numbers like half and fifty per cent, and phrasal verbs like put off, meaning postpone.
scenes.say_native: Yana bir necha tur. Faol va majhul: “They built it in 1990” va “It was built in 1990”. Umumiy va xususiy: “vehicles” mashina va avtobuslarni qamraydi. Raqamlar: “half” ellik foiz, “the majority” bu “most”. Frazali fe’l rasmiy fe’lga aylanadi: “put off” bu “postpone”, “find out” bu “discover”.
scenes.say_uz: Boshqa turlar: faol va majhul nisbat, umumiy va xususiy so‘zlar, yarmi va ellik foiz kabi raqamlar, put off, ya’ni postpone kabi frazali fe’llar.

scenes.title: Parafrazni eshitish
board: “Hardly anyone turned up.” → Attendance was low.
“It’s not worth the money.” → It is overpriced.
“I’d rather not commit yet.” → She is hesitant.
scenes.say: Hardly anyone turned up means attendance was low. It's not worth the money means it is overpriced. I'd rather not commit yet means she is hesitant.
scenes.say_native: Bu juftliklarga qarang. “Hardly anyone turned up” va “Attendance was low”: bitta umumiy so‘z yo‘q, lekin ma’no bir: deyarli hech kim kelmadi. “Not worth the money” va “overpriced”: narxi haddan ortiq. “I’d rather not commit yet” esa ikkilanish, ya’ni hesitant. Parafraz va munosabat ko‘pincha birga ishlaydi.
scenes.say_uz: Deyarli hech kim kelmadi, ya’ni qatnashuv past. Pulga arzimaydi, ya’ni narxi haddan ortiq. Hozircha majburiyat olmay turay, ya’ni ikkilanmoqda.

scenes.title: So‘z mosligi tuzog‘i
board: ✗ Same word heard → must be the answer
Q: What is NOT available? A) parking  B) Wi-Fi
“Parking’s free. The Wi-Fi… sorry, it’s down this week.”
scenes.say: Exam writers often put the exact word you hear into a wrong option. If parking is free but the Wi-Fi is down, the thing not available is the Wi-Fi.
scenes.say_native: So‘z mosligi tuzog‘i: variantdagi so‘zni yozuvda eshitib, darhol tanlaysiz. Ammo imtihon tuzuvchilar aynan shu so‘zni ko‘pincha noto‘g‘ri variantga qo‘yadi, to‘g‘ri javobni esa parafraz bilan beradi. “Wi-Fi is down” ya’ni ishlamayapti, demak “not available”. Bir xil so‘zni eshitsangiz, shubhalaning va ma’noni tekshiring.
scenes.say_uz: Imtihon tuzuvchilar eshitgan so‘zingizni ko‘pincha noto‘g‘ri variantga qo‘yadi. To‘xtash joyi bepul, Wi-Fi esa ishlamasa, mavjud bo‘lmagani Wi-Fi.

scenes.title: Parafrazlarni moslang
board: 1) The price has gone up a lot.   a) It was delayed.
2) Most of them disagreed.   b) It became much more expensive.
3) They put the launch off.   c) It wasn’t easy to reach.
4) Getting there was a real struggle.   d) The majority were against it.
scenes.say: Match each sentence with its paraphrase. One: the price has gone up a lot. Two: most of them disagreed. Three: they put the launch off. Four: getting there was a real struggle.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapni to‘rtta parafraz bilan moslang. Har juftlikda qaysi so‘z qaysi so‘zga mos kelishini toping: “gone up a lot” qaysi variantda boshqacha aytilgan? “Put off”ning rasmiy sinonimini eslang. Javobni raqam va harf bilan ayting, masalan “one b”.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapni parafrazi bilan moslang. Bir: narx ancha oshdi. Ikki: ko‘pchilik qo‘shilmadi. Uch: taqdimotni kechiktirishdi. To‘rt: u yerga yetib borish haqiqiy qiyinchilik edi.

scenes.title: Javoblar: parafraz
scenes.say: One b, two d, three a, four c.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir b: “gone up a lot” bu “much more expensive”. Ikki d: “most” bu “the majority”, “disagreed” bu “against it”. Uch a: “put off” bu “delayed”. To‘rt c: “a real struggle” bu “not easy”. Hech bir juftlikda bir xil kalit so‘z yo‘q. Siz so‘zlarni emas, ma’nolarni moslashtirdingiz.
scenes.say_uz: Bir b, ikki d, uch a, to‘rt c.

scenes.title: Tabiiy nutq: raqam va kuchsiz shakllar

examples.t: The bus leaves at four fifteen, not four fifty.
examples.uz: Avtobus to‘rt-u o‘n beshda jo‘naydi, to‘rt-u ellikda emas.

scenes.say: Thirteen, said alone, is stressed at the end; thirty at the start. Can is weak, but can't keeps its full vowel.
scenes.say_native: Ko‘p tafsilot tabiiy nutqda yo‘qoladi. “Thirteen” alohida aytilganda urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda va oxirida uzun “i:” bor, “thirty”da urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda. “Can” odatda kuchsiz, qisqa “kən”, “can’t” esa britancha talaffuzda to‘liq “kɑːnt”. So‘zlar ulanadi: “an hour”, “turn it off”.
scenes.say_uz: Thirteen alohida aytilganda oxiriga, thirty boshiga urg‘u oladi. Can kuchsiz, can’t esa to‘liq unlini saqlaydi.

scenes.title: Qaysi raqam?
scenes.say: Write what you hear. One: the class has fourteen students. Two: the flight is fifty minutes late. Three: the museum is seventeen kilometres away. Four: I can't come on Monday.
scenes.say_native: To‘rt gapni tinglang va raqamni yoki “can”, “can’t”ni yozing. Urg‘u oxirida bo‘lsa, “-teen”, boshida bo‘lsa, “-ty”. To‘rtinchi gapda unli uzunligiga va urg‘uga quloq soling. Keyin har bir javobni o‘zingiz ham baland ovozda, to‘g‘ri urg‘u bilan talaffuz qiling.
scenes.say_uz: Eshitganingizni yozing. Bir: sinfda o‘n to‘rt o‘quvchi bor. Ikki: reys ellik daqiqa kechikmoqda. Uch: muzey o‘n yetti kilometr uzoqda. To‘rt: dushanba kela olmayman.

scenes.title: Javoblar: raqamlar
scenes.say: One, fourteen. Two, fifty. Three, seventeen. Four, can't.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: fourTEEN, urg‘u oxirida. Ikki: FIFty, urg‘u boshida. Uch: sevenTEEN. To‘rt: can’t, u urg‘uli va aniq eshitildi. “I can come” bo‘lganida “can” juda qisqa bo‘lardi, urg‘u esa “come”ga tushardi. Gap ichida “fourteen students” kabi urg‘u ba’zan oldinga ko‘chadi, shuning uchun kontekstga ham tayaning.
scenes.say_uz: Bir, o‘n to‘rt. Ikki, ellik. Uch, o‘n yetti. To‘rt, can’t.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: ma’ruza
scenes.say: Today I'd like to talk about rooftop gardens. In Rotterdam, many flat roofs have become green spaces. Some people assumed the main benefit was food, but in fact the biggest gain has been rainwater control: green roofs absorb heavy rain and reduce flooding. They also cool buildings in summer. Admittedly, they are expensive to install. Even so, I'm convinced every new building should have one.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi, uzunroq tinglash: tom ustidagi bog‘lar haqida qisqa ma’ruza. Ikki ustunli qayd yozing: asosiy g‘oya, kamida uchta tafsilot va so‘zlovchining munosabati. Ehtiyot bo‘ling, ma’ruzada bitta chalg‘ituvchi bor. “In fact” va “admittedly” so‘zlari sizga yo‘l ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun tom ustidagi bog‘lar haqida gapirmoqchiman. Rotterdamda ko‘p tekis tomlar yashil maydonga aylandi. Ba’zilar asosiy foyda oziq-ovqat deb o‘ylagan, lekin aslida eng katta yutuq yomg‘ir suvini nazorat qilish: yashil tomlar kuchli yomg‘irni shimib, toshqinni kamaytiradi. Ular yozda binolarni sovutadi ham. Tan olish kerak, o‘rnatish qimmat. Shunday bo‘lsa-da, har bir yangi binoda shunday tom bo‘lishi kerakligiga ishonaman.

scenes.title: Ma’ruza bo‘yicha savollar
board: 2) Biggest benefit: A) food  B) rainwater control  C) cooling
4) Attitude: sceptical / indifferent / strongly in favour?
scenes.say: Use your notes. One: what is the main idea? Two: what is the biggest benefit? Three: which disadvantage is mentioned? Four: what is the speaker's attitude?
scenes.say_native: Qaydlaringizga qarab javob bering. Asosiy g‘oyani bitta gapda ayting. Ikkinchi savolda uchala variant ham ma’ruzada tilga olingan, lekin qaysi biri “the biggest”? Kamchilik qaysi so‘zdan keyin kelganini eslang. Munosabat uchun so‘nggi gapga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say_uz: Qaydlaringizdan foydalaning. Bir: asosiy g‘oya nima? Ikki: eng katta foyda nima? Uch: qaysi kamchilik aytildi? To‘rt: so‘zlovchining munosabati qanday?

scenes.title: Javoblar: ma’ruza
board: 1) Rooftop gardens bring real benefits to cities.
scenes.say: One: rooftop gardens bring real benefits to cities. Two: B, rainwater control. Three: they are expensive to install. Four: strongly in favour.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: tom bog‘lari shaharlarga real foyda keltiradi. Ikki: B, yomg‘ir suvi nazorati. Oziq-ovqat chalg‘ituvchi edi: “some people assumed” bilan kiritilib, “in fact” bilan tuzatildi. Uch: o‘rnatish qimmat, bu “admittedly”dan keyin keldi. To‘rt: qat’iy tarafdor, “I’m convinced” buni ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: tom bog‘lari shaharlarga real foyda keltiradi. Ikki: B, yomg‘ir suvini nazorat qilish. Uch: o‘rnatish qimmat. To‘rt: qat’iy tarafdor.

scenes.title: Tinglash strategiyasi
board: DURING: two-column notes, signposts, turning words
AFTER: check spelling, numbers, word limit
scenes.say: Read and predict before, take notes during, and check spelling and word limits after. Never leave a blank.
scenes.say_native: Hammasini bitta strategiyaga yig‘amiz. Oldin: savollarni o‘qing, tagiga chizing, bashorat qiling. Tinglash paytida: ikki ustunli qayd, ishora va burilish so‘zlari. Keyin: imlo, raqam va so‘z chegarasini tekshiring. “No more than two words” desa, uch so‘z yozish xato. Va hech qachon bo‘sh joy qoldirmang.
scenes.say_uz: Oldin o‘qing va bashorat qiling, tinglayotib qayd yozing, keyin imlo va so‘z chegarasini tekshiring. Hech qachon bo‘sh qoldirmang.

scenes.title: Og‘zaki xulosa
board: Summarise the rooftop talk in 4 sentences
scenes.say: Now summarise the rooftop gardens talk aloud in four sentences: the main idea, two details and the speaker's attitude. Use your own words.
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy amaliy topshiriq. Qaydlaringizga qarab, ma’ruzani to‘rt gapda og‘zaki xulosa qiling: asosiy g‘oya, ikki tafsilot va munosabat. So‘zlovchining so‘zlarini takrorlamang, parafraz qiling. Masalan, “absorb rain” o‘rniga “soak up water”. Ovozingizni yozib olsangiz, yanada yaxshi.
scenes.say_uz: Endi tom bog‘lari haqidagi ma’ruzani to‘rt gapda og‘zaki xulosa qiling: asosiy g‘oya, ikki tafsilot va munosabat. O‘z so‘zlaringizni ishlating.

scenes.title: Namunaviy xulosa
board: Rooftop gardens are very useful for cities.
They soak up heavy rain and help prevent floods.
They keep buildings cooler, but cost a lot to set up.
scenes.say: Here is a model summary. Notice the paraphrases: soak up, prevent floods, and cost a lot to set up.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna. E’tibor bering: “absorb” o‘rniga “soak up”, “reduce flooding” o‘rniga “prevent floods”, “expensive to install” o‘rniga “cost a lot to set up”. Bu parafraz. Munosabat “clearly supports” bilan berildi. Sizning xulosangiz boshqacha bo‘lishi tabiiy, shu to‘rt qism bo‘lsa, vazifa bajarildi.
scenes.say_uz: Mana namunaviy xulosa. Parafrazlarga e’tibor bering: shimib olmoq, toshqinning oldini olmoq va o‘rnatishga ko‘p pul ketmoq.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Notes: two columns, key words, symbols
Distractors: wait for the final answer
scenes.say: Today we practised structured notes, identifying attitude, avoiding distractors and recognising paraphrase.
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Birinchi: qayd yozish, ya’ni ikki ustun, kalit so‘zlar va belgilar. Ikkinchi: munosabat so‘zlar va ohang orqali, sceptical bilan critical farqi. Uchinchi: chalg‘ituvchilar, yakuniy javobni kutish va burilish so‘zlari. To‘rtinchi: parafraz, so‘zni emas, ma’noni tinglash. Va -teen bilan -ty farqini unutmang.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun tartibli qayd yozish, munosabatni aniqlash, chalg‘ituvchilardan qochish va parafrazni tanishni mashq qildik.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Homework: listen to a 3–5 minute talk
Success: 1 main idea + 5 details + 1 sentence on attitude
scenes.say: For homework, listen to a three to five minute talk, take notes and write six key points in your own words. Next time: reading, skimming and scanning.
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: uch-besh daqiqalik ingliz tilidagi ma’ruza yoki podkastni tinglang, ikki ustunli qayd yozing va oltita asosiy fikrni o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan yozing. Mezon: bitta asosiy g‘oya, beshta tafsilot va munosabat haqida bitta gap. Keyingi darsda o‘qish strategiyasi: tez ko‘z yugurtirish va qidirishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: uch-besh daqiqalik ma’ruza tinglang, qayd yozing va oltita asosiy fikrni o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan yozing. Keyingi safar: o‘qish, tez ko‘z yugurtirish va qidirish.

homework_uz: 3–5 daqiqalik ingliz tilidagi ma’ruza yoki podkastni tinglang, ikki ustunli qayd yozing va oltita asosiy fikrni o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan yozing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: bitta asosiy g‘oya, beshta aniq tafsilot (kamida bittasi raqam yoki ism) va so‘zlovchining munosabati haqida bitta gap.

quiz.q: In two-column notes, what goes in the left column?
quiz.why_uz: Chap ustunga asosiy fikrlar, o‘ngga tafsilotlar yoziladi.

quiz.q: “It sounds good on paper, but I’m not sure it’ll work.” The speaker is…
quiz.why_uz: “But I’m not sure” shubhani bildiradi, ya’ni sceptical.

quiz.q: What does “I couldn’t agree more” mean?
quiz.why_uz: Inkor shaklida bo‘lsa ham, bu to‘liq qo‘shilishni bildiradi.

quiz.q: “The meeting is on the 14th… sorry, the 15th.” When is the meeting?
“We could drive, but parking is a nightmare, so let’s take the train.” How will they travel?
quiz.why_uz: Mashina “but” bilan rad etildi, yakuniy qaror poyezd.

quiz.q: Which word most often signals a correction?
quiz.why_uz: “Actually” ko‘pincha tuzatish yoki kutilmagan fikrni boshlaydi.

quiz.q: Best paraphrase of “They put the launch off until May”:
options: They launched it early in May.
The launch was postponed until May.
They put the launch on in May.

quiz.why_uz: “Hardly anyone” deyarli hech kim, ya’ni qatnashuv past.

quiz.q: Which word is stressed on the FIRST syllable?
quiz.why_uz: -ty bilan tugaydigan raqamlar birinchi bo‘g‘inga urg‘u oladi: FIFty.
